title: A pricing helper is tidied up and split into two small functions, with no change in behaviour
diff:
diff --git a/app/utils/pricing.py b/app/utils/pricing.py
--- a/app/utils/pricing.py
+++ b/app/utils/pricing.py
@@ -1,7 +1,13 @@
-def total_price(items):
-    t = 0
-    for i in items:
-        t = t + i["price"] * i["qty"]
-    if t > 100:
-        t = t * 0.9
-    return t
+BULK_THRESHOLD = 100
+BULK_DISCOUNT = 0.9
+
+
+def subtotal(items: list[dict]) -> float:
+    return sum(item["price"] * item["qty"] for item in items)
+
+
+def total_price(items: list[dict]) -> float:
+    total = subtotal(items)
+    if total > BULK_THRESHOLD:
+        total *= BULK_DISCOUNT
+    return total
